blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Kiko Pangilinan brought some levity to the Senate committee on finance’s budget deliberations for the Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) on Thursday, breaking into a song with a line from his wife Sharon Cuneta’s hit “Bituing Walang Ningning.” After discussing how better-organized farmers could help boost food supply and reduce hunger, Pangilinan sang the famous line, “Balutin mo ako,” while gesturing as if he was packing food. Pangilinan was discussing the need to properly organize farmers and connect them directly with institutional buyers, including government agencies, so they could earn more from their produce. “Pag marami nang […]...
